subject: School Transition and Family Communication Protocols
overview: The subcommittee met with district administrators to review and refine communication protocols for school transitions, including registration processes and the scheduling of end-of-year events. Staff identified successful outreach strategies for kindergarten and discussed ways to better support families navigating the move between elementary, middle, and high schools.

items.title: Kindergarten Registration Outreach
items.summary: Staff reported that proactive outreach using census data and community liaisons resulted in significantly higher early enrollment numbers, particularly at the Missituk school. The district plans to create a one-page roadmap to guide new families through the registration and screening timeline.

items.title: After School Enrollment and Lottery
items.summary: Administrators proposed converting dense website documentation into a simplified FAQ format to address common family concerns about the lottery and waitlist. A public forum and focus group regarding after-school programs is scheduled for late July.

items.title: Elementary to Middle School Transition
items.summary: The district reviewed current transition activities, including open houses and student panels, while identifying a need for earlier communication regarding world language preferences. Suggestions were made to send middle school student ambassadors to elementary schools to address younger students' concerns about the lottery process.

items.title: Middle to High School Transition
items.summary: Principals discussed improving the academic representation at open houses and providing parents with clearer roadmaps for the course selection process. The committee suggested involving parent advisory groups to help translate complex high school scheduling language for middle school families.

items.title: End-of-Year Event Coordination and Calendaring
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed the need for earlier notification regarding field trip expenses and better synchronization of school-based and PTO-led events. Staff are working to make internal Google Calendars more accessible and filterable for families with students in multiple buildings.
